name: LanPaint overdamped inner loop (full read, replaces name-level lanpaint-langevin)
plain: Before each outer sampler step, LanPaint runs a few inner steps of a noisy relaxation over the whole latent, so the masked area and the kept area can agree before the outer step moves on. The kept region is pulled toward the source image and also nudged by a second guided prediction, the "BIG" one. The code uses an exact Ornstein-Uhlenbeck step, the overdamped limit; the second-order damped oscillator is commented out.
math:
Time conversion. Flow: abt=(1−σ)²/((1−σ)²+σ²), σ_VE=σ/(1−σ). VE: abt=1/(1+σ²).
m=1−(denoise_mask>0.5), 1 on kept pixels. Replace step: x←x(1−m)+noise_scaling(σ,noise,y)·m.
x_t=x·(√abt+√(1−abt)) on flow, x/√(1+σ²) on VE. Convert back for each model call.
Score: s=−(x_t−x̂₀)(1−m) + [−(1+λ)(x_t−y)+λ(x_t−x̂₀ᴮ)]m, x̂₀ at cfg, x̂₀ᴮ at cfg_BIG.
Drift: A=1/(1−abt) unknown, (1+λ)/(1−abt) known. C=(√abt(x_t+s)−x_t)/(1−abt)+A x_t. D=√2.
Step: dt=η·max(1−abt,f)·(1 unknown, β known), η=StepSize, f=MinStepFrac.
OU(dt): x←e^(−A dt)x+k C+√(D²k₂)·n, k=(1−e^(−A dt))/A, k₂=(1−e^(−2A dt))/(2A).
First inner step: OU(dt). Later: OU(dt/2); C′=C(x); x+=(C′−C)dt; OU(dt/2).
End: x̂₀ from one more model call at the converted x, kept region overwritten by y; the in-place x carries the relaxed latent back to the outer sampler.

props.stages: NumSteps inner calls + 1 per outer step; each call runs cond and uncond once, then cfg_function twice
